node.title: Re^3: How to redefine a modules private function?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I'm wondering if there is essentially no difference between doing: sub DOMAIN_PORT() { 53 } and use constant DOMAIN_PORT => 53; Is there any difference at all ?

AFAIK not really, other than that [doc://constant] does some checks on the constant names and that it keeps track of declared constants in %constant::declared - but they should both produce a [doc://perlsub#Constant-Functions|constant function]. (Even today you can still find the [https://github.com/Perl/perl5/blob/v5.34.0/dist/constant/lib/constant.pm#L174|line] *$full_name = sub () { $scalar }; in constant.pm.)
